description: Source code for handling webhooks in Mattermost server, including outgoing and incoming webhooks, webhook event processing, and command webhooks.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods for webhook handling and related operations.

methods.name: handleWebhookEvents
methods.description: Processes outgoing webhook events triggered by a post in an open channel.

methods.name: TriggerWebhook
methods.description: Sends a webhook payload to all callback URLs associated with a webhook, handling OAuth tokens and response processing.

methods.name: doOutgoingWebhookRequest
methods.description: Performs the HTTP POST request for an outgoing webhook, with timeout and error handling.

methods.name: splitWebhookPost
methods.description: Splits a post message into multiple posts if it exceeds maximum size, including handling attachments.

methods.name: CreateWebhookPost
methods.description: Creates a new post in a channel as a result of a webhook, parsing links and handling properties.

methods.name: CreateIncomingWebhookForChannel
methods.description: Creates a new incoming webhook for a specific channel.

methods.name: UpdateIncomingWebhook
methods.description: Updates an existing incoming webhook.

methods.name: DeleteIncomingWebhook
methods.description: Deletes an incoming webhook by ID.

methods.name: GetIncomingWebhook
methods.description: Retrieves an incoming webhook by ID.

methods.name: GetIncomingWebhooksForTeamPage
methods.description: Retrieves paginated incoming webhooks for a team.

methods.name: GetIncomingWebhooksForTeamPageByUser
methods.description: Retrieves paginated incoming webhooks for a team filtered by user.

methods.name: GetIncomingWebhooksPageByUser
methods.description: Retrieves paginated incoming webhooks for a user.

methods.name: GetIncomingWebhooksCount
methods.description: Returns count of incoming webhooks for a team and user.

methods.name: CreateOutgoingWebhook
methods.description: Creates a new outgoing webhook, with validation for channel and trigger overlaps.

methods.name: UpdateOutgoingWebhook
methods.description: Updates an existing outgoing webhook with validation.

methods.name: GetOutgoingWebhook
methods.description: Retrieves an outgoing webhook by ID.

methods.name: GetOutgoingWebhooksPage
methods.description: Retrieves paginated outgoing webhooks.

methods.name: GetOutgoingWebhooksPageByUser
methods.description: Retrieves paginated outgoing webhooks filtered by user.

methods.name: GetOutgoingWebhooksForChannelPageByUser
methods.description: Retrieves outgoing webhooks for a channel filtered by user.

methods.name: GetOutgoingWebhooksForTeamPage
methods.description: Retrieves outgoing webhooks for a team.

methods.name: GetOutgoingWebhooksForTeamPageByUser
methods.description: Retrieves outgoing webhooks for a team filtered by user.

methods.name: DeleteOutgoingWebhook
methods.description: Deletes an outgoing webhook by ID.

methods.name: RegenOutgoingWebhookToken
methods.description: Regenerates the token for an outgoing webhook.

methods.name: HandleIncomingWebhook
methods.description: Processes an incoming webhook request, creating a post in the specified channel.

methods.name: CreateCommandWebhook
methods.description: Creates a webhook associated with a command.

methods.name: HandleCommandWebhook
methods.description: Handles execution of a command webhook response.
